name: hoopslab
description: NBA + EuroLeague cross-league translation modelling, served from the edge
author: Kutlu Mizrak

scripts.type: npm run type -w hoopslab-api && npm run type -w hoopslab-web
scripts.ml:lint: uv run --project services/ml ruff check services/ml
scripts.ml:format:check: uv run --project services/ml ruff format --check services/ml
scripts.db:migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply hoopslab-dev --local --config apps/api/wrangler.toml --env dev
scripts.db:load: wrangler d1 execute hoopslab-dev --local --config apps/api/wrangler.toml --env dev --file data/d1/load.sql
scripts.db:load:demo: wrangler d1 execute hoopslab-dev --local --config apps/api/wrangler.toml --env dev --file data/d1/load-demo.sql
scripts.db:migrate:prod: wrangler d1 migrations apply hoopslab-prod --remote --config apps/api/wrangler.toml --env production
scripts.db:load:prod: wrangler d1 execute hoopslab-prod --remote --config apps/api/wrangler.toml --env production --file data/d1/load-demo.sql
scripts.deploy:web: rimraf apps/web/.next apps/web/.open-next && npm run build:cf -w hoopslab-web && npm run deploy -w hoopslab-web
